notes:
STATUS: evaluation - POC under way. Goal: replace legacy search (Elasticsearch + custom TF-IDF) for 18PB of mixed media transcripts and long-form articles. Primary constraints: long-doc chunking strategy, reranker latency, and cost per query.

RECENT TIMELINE:
- 2026-02-12 discovery call (Jordan + Maya) — agreed POC scope: 5M doc subset, 300M tokens, focus on news + video transcripts. Fireflies: ff_2026-02-12_emberly_poc.
- 2026-02-20 infra sync w/Eng infra (internal) — sizing: plan for 8 GPU dedicated pool for prototype throughput tests.
- 2026-03-02 model & reranker deep-dive (Maya + ML lead) — cross-encoder vs two-stage bi+cross experiments. Fireflies: ff_2026-03-02_archival-search-call.
- 2026-03-08 sample run complete — vector index (dense) + FAISS IVFPQ baseline, avg embed size 1536 dims, index ~1.2B vectors projected for full corpus.

TECHNICAL NOTES / CUSTOMER REQUIREMENTS:
- Docs: very long (avg 6k-25k tokens). Need chunking w/overlap. Customer prefers semantic chunking (paragraph + scene boundaries) over fixed 1k-token windows to preserve context where possible.
- Embeddings: prefer open models but willing to test Redwood-verified models (1536d + 1024d) for cost tradeoffs.
- Reranker: want two-stage system — sparse/ANN recall -> cross-encoder rerank for top-K. Key ask: P95 rerank latency < 120ms for interactive use, < 40ms for programmatic batch edges.
- Throughput & latency targets: median end-to-end (query->top10) < 300ms for hosted low-latency path; for dedicated P50 < 120ms under 100 qps sustained.
- Cost goals: target <$0.02 per query (top10 retrieval + rerank) for steady-state at 100k qpm equivalent monthly volume; POC acceptance if average query cost < $0.05.
- Indexing: require incremental updates (daily ingestion), TTL on drafts, provenance metadata preserved. Retention rules for PII.
- Routing/fallbacks: want automatic fallback to smaller quantized model for burst protection and region fallback for EU queries (data residency).

POC DETAILS & METRICS TO CAPTURE:
- Compare chunking strategies: fixed windows (1k token, 512 overlap) vs semantic paragraphs (~200-800 tokens variable) vs hierarchical (coarse chunk + subchunk). Track recall@10, nDCG, and reranker cost/time.
- Reranker tuning: evaluate cross-encoder distillation, early-exit, and cascade reranking to reduce per-doc cost. Test K candidates of 100/50/20 to find cost/latency sweet spot.
- Caching: implement prefix/KV caching for repeated queries; measure hit rate and delta on cost per query.
- Index sharding: propose time-based sharding + hot shard for recent content to reduce tail latency.

STAKEHOLDERS & DECISION CRITERIA:
- Product lead (Clara J.) cares most about quality (nDCG) for newsroom workflows.
- Platform/Infra (Raj P.) focused on operational cost and autoscaling for nightly ingest.
- Security (Amira T.) needs KMS, SOC2 attestations, and region-specific residency.
- Procurement wants 12–24mo committed pricing for Dedicated if POC meets targets.

QUOTES / CUSTOMER FEEDBACK (paraphrased):
- "We can't lose narrative context mid-article — chunking must be content-aware."
- "If reranking adds 200ms per query we won't ship to editors."

NEXT STEPS:
- Week of 2026-03-15: run two-stage experiments with K=50 and semantic chunker. Engineer to instrument per-stage latency/cost.
- Legal to confirm EU residency options (drive:/shared/emberly/security/q4-security-deck.pdf).
- Follow-up demo: dedicated sizing + cost model (owner Jordan, SE Maya).

BLOCKERS: data residency confirmation; decision on semantic chunker (do we build in-house or use third-party); precise budget for Dedicated GPUs.
